findings.title: enableSqlExpressions dereferences features without nil check causing panic
findings.body: In pkg/expr/reader.go enableSqlExpressions unconditionally does h.features.IsEnabledGlobally(...). The SQL path previously never touched features, so callers/tests with a nil *ExpressionQueryReader or nil FeatureToggles worked. Now a SQL query with such a reader panics with nil-pointer/nil-interface dereference instead of returning the controlled "sqlExpressions is not implemented" error, turning a rejected query into a server panic/DoS.

findings.title: Legacy SQL entry point has no explicit disabled guard
findings.body: In pkg/expr/sql_command.go UnmarshalSQLCommand/NewSQLCommand has no enableSqlExpressions check. The PR only guards ExpressionQueryReader.ReadQuery in pkg/expr/reader.go and relies on the stub sql.DB in pkg/expr/sql/db.go returning "not implemented" from TablesList to fail NewSQLCommand. Any caller of the legacy rawNode path, direct construction of SQLCommand, mock DB, or future restoration of a real DB bypasses the explicit disable and re-exposes SQL execution/RCE that this CVE fix is supposed to hard-disable. Both entry points need an explicit reject.
